data.name: DAMASCUS: Road to Redemption
data.detailed_description:
DAMASCUS: Road to Redemption is a cinematic third-person action RPG inspired by the biblical account of Saul’s transformation into Paul the Apostle.

Step into ancient Jerusalem during a time of political tension, religious persecution, and growing unrest. Begin your journey as Saul, a feared persecutor tasked with hunting believers before a life-changing encounter on the road to Damascus changes everything.

Explore historically inspired environments, including Jerusalem streets, ancient marketplaces, military outposts, wilderness roads, and early believer hideouts as you progress through a narrative-driven story built for gamers first.

FEATURES

• Third-person cinematic action gameplay

• Narrative-driven missions inspired by biblical events

• Sword combat and enemy encounters

• Stealth and pursuit mechanics

• Exploration of ancient cities and wilderness environments

• Cinematic cutscenes and immersive storytelling

• Character progression and story-based transformation

• Atmospheric soundtrack and dramatic visual presentation

• Historically inspired environments created in Unreal Engine 5

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
